mapper.sql: id, paper_id, question_index, knowledge_point, question_content, blank_answer, reference_answer, explanation, user_answer, score, correct, ai_comment, suggestion, answered_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM quick_review_question WHERE paper_id = #{paperId} ORDER BY question_index ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO quick_review_question ( paper_id, question_index, knowledge_point, question_content, blank_answer, reference_answer, explanation, user_answer, score, correct, ai_comment, suggestion, answered_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{paperId}, #{questionIndex}, #{knowledgePoint}, #{questionContent}, #{blankAnswer}, #{referenceAnswer}, #{explanation}, #{userAnswer}, #{score}, #{correct}, #{aiComment}, #{suggestion}, #{answeredAt}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE quick_review_question SET user_answer = #{userAnswer}, score = #{score}, correct = #{correct}, ai_comment = #{aiComment}, suggestion = #{suggestion}, answered_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE paper_id = #{paperId} AND question_index = #{questionIndex}
